source.scope: Real codex-cli to loopback HTTP/SSE and WS receiver only. JPEG/WebP/GIF/original requests call view_image on task-owned 8x5 images; SVG is a task-owned inline vector file offered without rasterization. No upstream calls or user configuration edits. Original uses gpt-5.5 metadata; other cases use gpt-5.1 fallback metadata.
source.redaction: Messages, instructions, descriptions, paths, IDs and metadata identifiers sanitized; catalog references resolve against shared fixture.
source.catalogs: JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG use the prior shared 106-function catalog; original scenarios use the separately captured 13-item gpt-5.5 native catalog.

format.definition:
start: begin_patch hunk+ end_patch
begin_patch: "*** Begin Patch" LF
end_patch: "*** End Patch" LF?

hunk: add_hunk | delete_hunk | update_hunk
add_hunk: "*** Add File: " filename LF add_line+
delete_hunk: "*** Delete File: " filename LF
update_hunk: "*** Update File: " filename LF change_move? change?

filename: /(.+)/
add_line: "+" /(.*)/ LF -> line

change_move: "*** Move to: " filename LF
change: (change_context | change_line)+ eof_line?
change_context: ("@@" | "@@ " /(.+)/) LF
change_line: ("+" | "-" | " ") /(.*)/ LF
eof_line: "*** End of File" LF

%import common.LF
